# bouncing-dots

## Size: density from context (no prop)

A `BouncingDots`'s dot diameter has **no prop** — it tracks the ambient
`ControlSize` (`useControlSize`), mapping the four density tiers to
`xs → size-1`, `sm → size-1`, `md → size-1.5`, `lg → size-2`. Deliberate sizing
is a `<ControlSizeProvider size>` around the region (mirroring `Badge`), never a
per-instance `size`; passing one is a compile error (`size?: never`). The
no-provider default is `md`.

## Plugin reference
